name: ARMM
group: Misra, Surgical Robotics Lab, University of Twente
versions: single (RA-L 2020); coil optimisation in Sikorski 2019 (cited, not read); 2016: Twente (Misra) magnetically actuated catheter in closed loop on 2D ultrasound (Boskma, Scheggi, Misra 2016 BioRob) (Alekseeva 2025 Table 12 row 6) (alekseeva2025_design)
target_anatomy: iliac / aortic phantom from CT of a 62-year-old (gelatin torso phantom, pulsating flow)
devices_driven: commercial Sherpa NX Active 2 mm coronary guide catheter (500 mm) with five NdFeB magnets (2 mm x 2 mm) in the tip
n_dof_detail: two UR manipulators (UR10 carries the electromagnetic coil, UR5 carries the ultrasound probe) plus a 1-axis catheter insertion device
translation_detail: magnetic (steering); separate insertion device, servo-driven gear and bearing, 1.3-6.4 mm/s, takes 3-34 Fr
footprint_mm: workspace sphere radius 783 mm (max 1300 mm); 9 m3 environment
force_sensing: none; tip tracked by ultrasound (30 Hz) and motion capture
imaging_compat: 3D ultrasound feedback, optical motion capture; radiation-free
validation_detail: gelatin torso phantom with pulsating flow, 3D targets, PI control; target count N.R. in my read
key_numbers: coil at least 20 mT and over 0.6 mT/mm at 50-200 mm; mean tip error 2.09 +/- 0.49 mm; median time to target 32.6 s
sim_model: none found (dipole-field actuation model; no simulator)
